# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Updated the startup scenario selection summary so it no longer presents gross filled-prism volume as if it were the chemistry-facing water volume. Added `StartupSubstratePreset::total_depth_cm()` in `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs` to derive substrate displacement from the selected preset, then changed `crates/tank_tui/src/main.rs` to show both `Filled capacity ... gross` and `Net water volume ... after substrate displacement` in the launch summary.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Inspected the startup selection summary in `crates/tank_tui/src/main.rs` and confirmed the existing `Filled volume` line was using `geometry.water_volume_l()` (gross filled-prism volume) even though chemistry now uses substrate-adjusted net water volume.
1. [Completed] Added `StartupSubstratePreset::total_depth_cm()` in `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs`, sourced from the actual substrate preset data behind each startup substrate choice so the UI can compute substrate displacement without hardcoded duplicated depths.
2. [Completed] Updated the launch summary in `crates/tank_tui/src/main.rs` to compute `gross_volume_l` and substrate-adjusted `net_volume_l`, replacing the ambiguous single-line volume display with separate gross-capacity and net-water-volume lines.
3. [Completed] Ran formatter, targeted package tests, full workspace tests, clippy, and source-level sanity checks to verify the UI remediation and keep the workspace clean.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo fmt --all --check` completed successfully.
- `cargo test --quiet -p tank_scenarios` completed successfully.
- `cargo test --quiet -p tank_tui` completed successfully.
- `cargo test --quiet` completed successfully across the workspace.
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --quiet` completed successfully.
- `rg -n "total_depth_cm|Filled capacity|Net water volume" crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs crates/tank_tui/src/main.rs` confirms the new preset-depth helper and the two clarified launch-summary volume lines are present.
- No `.beads/` files changed in this remediation pass, so `br lint` was not required.

## Outstanding Risks

- The launch summary now derives net water volume from the selected startup substrate preset depths; if the startup flow later supports arbitrary per-layer substrate edits, this preview should switch to reading the materialized state instead of enum-based preset depth totals.
- The startup screen is still a geometry-and-preset preview rather than a fully materialized chemistry preview, so any future preview metrics beyond volume should be sourced from the finalized overridden state to avoid drift.
